verdict.rationale: Both PRs make the same removal: the flag, its field and default, its parse arm, the compact renderer and helper, its tests, the help line, the README row and a CHANGELOG entry. B removes the compact tests cleanly. A leaves a stray blank line before the closing brace of the render test module, which rustfmt would flag. B's report and changelog entry also state the user-visible result more concretely: `-c` now gives an unknown-option error with exit code 2.
